BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing costsharing in medical programs; andamending RCW 74.09.055.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 74.09.055 and 2003 1st sp.s. c 14 s 1 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department is authorized to establish copayment, deductible, orcoinsurance((, or other costsharing)) requirements for recipients ofany medical programs defined in RCW 74.09.010.
